{{Top|leg}}
A '''Solid Fuel Converter''' was a type of [[Fuel converter]] that could convert virtually any matter into power for [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cells]]. It required five [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of light materials&mdash;including [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], [[Water/Legends|water]], [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]], [[cellulose]], and waste material&mdash;to recharge a single [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]]. Heavier materials, such as [[Uranium/Legends|uranium]] and [[plutonium]], can recharge a single cell with only one metric ton of material.
